tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures indicate a mobility bridge with flux conservation, but the available rows are a single fixed-horizon input sweep and cannot identify the transfer mechanism. Acquire the targeted open-branch probe before fitting a model.

considered_alternatives.option: author a saturating Beverton–Holt or bilinear snapshot model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now while holding the other inputs and H fixed, so they do not identify the hinted bridge dynamics or distinguish snapshot response from an open-branch transfer.
A more expensive dense trajectory batch is unnecessary before a targeted branch-opening observation resolves the main ambiguity.
It is unrelated to the observed bridge/flux signatures and should not be purchased.
